Between 1 and 10 October 2026, repeat customers generated **€1,850.34** out of the total **€2,137.34** in revenue, representing **86.57%** of overall revenue. ### High Repeat Customer Dominance Repeat customers accounted for over 86.5% of total revenue during the first 10 days of October 2026, driven by higher transaction volumes and order amounts compared to first-time buyers (€287.00 across 7 first-time orders).

WITH order_ranks AS
  (SELECT order_id,
          customer_id,
          order_date,
          amount,
          status,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id
                             ORDER BY order_date,
                                      order_ts,
                                      order_id) AS customer_order_seq,
                            COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS total_customer_orders
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE status != 'cancelled' ),
     period_orders AS
  (SELECT order_id,
          customer_id,
          order_date,
          amount,
          customer_order_seq,
          total_customer_orders,
          CASE
              WHEN customer_order_seq > 1 THEN 'repeat_order'
              ELSE 'first_order'
          END AS order_repeat_status
   FROM order_ranks
   WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-10' )
SELECT SUM(CASE
               WHEN customer_order_seq > 1 THEN amount
               ELSE 0
           END) AS repeat_customer_revenue,
       SUM(amount) AS total_revenue,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE
                                 WHEN customer_order_seq > 1 THEN amount
                                 ELSE 0
                             END), SUM(amount)) * 100, 2) AS repeat_revenue_pct
FROM period_orders;

Revenue in the week starting Monday, 14 September 2026 grew by **32.65%** compared to the prior week (rising from €2,340.50 to €3,104.75).

args.sql:
WITH weekly_revenue AS
  (SELECT CASE
              WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-07' AND '2026-09-13' THEN 'prior_week'
              WHEN order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-14' AND '2026-09-20' THEN 'target_week'
          END AS week_period,
          SUM(amount) AS revenue
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-07' AND '2026-09-20'
     AND LOWER(status) != 'cancelled'
   GROUP BY week_period)
SELECT prior.revenue AS prior_week_revenue,
       target.revenue AS target_week_revenue,
       target.revenue - prior.revenue AS revenue_change,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(target.revenue - prior.revenue, prior.revenue) * 100, 2) AS growth_percentage
FROM
  (SELECT revenue
   FROM weekly_revenue
   WHERE week_period = 'prior_week') AS
PRIOR
CROSS JOIN
  (SELECT revenue
   FROM weekly_revenue
   WHERE week_period = 'target_week') AS target

WITH daily_bookings AS
  (SELECT DAY,
          SUM(bookings) AS total_bookings
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.legacy.channel_daily`
   WHERE DAY BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-07' AND DATE '2026-09-20'
   GROUP BY DAY),
     weekly_summary AS
  (SELECT CASE
              WHEN DAY BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-07' AND DATE '2026-09-13' THEN 'Previous Week (Sep 07 - Sep 13)'
              WHEN DAY BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-09-20' THEN 'Target Week (Sep 14 - Sep 20)'
          END AS week_period,
          SUM(total_bookings) AS total_bookings
   FROM daily_bookings
   GROUP BY week_period)
SELECT prev.total_bookings AS previous_week_bookings,
       curr.total_bookings AS target_week_bookings,
       curr.total_bookings - prev.total_bookings AS bookings_growth,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(curr.total_bookings - prev.total_bookings, prev.total_bookings) * 100, 2) AS growth_percentage
FROM
  (SELECT total_bookings
   FROM weekly_summary
   WHERE week_period = 'Target Week (Sep 14 - Sep 20)') curr
CROSS JOIN
  (SELECT total_bookings
   FROM weekly_summary
   WHERE week_period = 'Previous Week (Sep 07 - Sep 13)') prev

       curr.total_leads - prev.total_leads AS leads_diff,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(curr.total_leads - prev.total_leads, prev.total_leads) * 100, 2) AS wow_growth_percentage
FROM weekly_leads AS curr
LEFT JOIN weekly_leads AS prev ON prev.week_start_date = DATE_SUB(curr.week_start_date, INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
WHERE curr.week_start_date = DATE '2026-09-14';

WITH legacy_sales AS
  (SELECT sales_date,
          gross_revenue,

   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.legacy.daily_net_sales`
   WHERE sales_date = DATE '2026-10-01' ),

          SUM(CASE
                  WHEN LOWER(status) != 'cancelled' THEN amount
                  ELSE 0
              END) AS gross_revenue
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`
   WHERE order_date = DATE '2026-10-01'
   GROUP BY order_date),

   GROUP BY return_date)
SELECT l.sales_date,
       l.gross_revenue AS legacy_gross_revenue,
       l.returns_amount AS legacy_returns_amount,
       l.net_revenue AS legacy_net_revenue,
       o.gross_revenue AS calculated_gross_revenue,
       COALESCE(r.returns_amount, 0) AS calculated_returns_amount,
       o.gross_revenue - COALESCE(r.returns_amount, 0) AS calculated_net_revenue
FROM silver_orders o
LEFT JOIN silver_returns r ON o.sales_date = r.sales_date
LEFT JOIN legacy_sales l ON o.sales_date = l.sales_date

   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`

     AND LOWER(status) != 'cancelled'

       COALESCE(o.gross_revenue, 0) AS silver_gross_revenue,
       COALESCE(r.returns_amount, 0) AS silver_returns_amount,
       COALESCE(o.gross_revenue, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_amount, 0) AS silver_net_revenue,
       l.gross_revenue AS legacy_gross_revenue,

       l.net_revenue AS legacy_net_revenue

FULL OUTER JOIN daily_returns r ON o.order_date = r.return_date
FULL OUTER JOIN legacy_sales l ON COALESCE(o.order_date, r.return_date) = l.sales_date

turns.text: The net revenue of **€964.19** on **1 October 2026** was calculated as follows: 1. **Gross Revenue (€981.69):** The sum of all non-cancelled order amounts (`amount`) placed on `2026-10-01` from `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders`. 2. **Returns (€17.50):** The sum of all partner return amounts (`amount`) processed on `2026-10-01` from `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns`. 3. **Net Revenue (€964.19):** Gross Revenue minus Returns: $$\text{Net Revenue} = €981.69 - €17.50 = €964.19$$ ### SQL Query Used ```sql WITH daily_orders AS ( SELECT order_date, SUM(amount) AS gross_revenue FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.orders` WHERE order_date = '2026-10-01' AND LOWER(status) != 'cancelled' GROUP BY order_date ), daily_returns AS ( SELECT return_date, SUM(amount) AS returns_amount FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.silver.returns` WHERE return_date = '2026-10-01' GROUP BY return_date ) SELECT COALESCE(o.order_date, r.return_date) AS sales_date, COALESCE(o.gross_revenue, 0) AS gross_revenue, COALESCE(r.returns_amount, 0) AS returns_amount, COALESCE(o.gross_revenue, 0) - COALESCE(r.returns_amount, 0) AS net_revenue FROM daily_orders o FULL OUTER JOIN daily_returns r ON o.order_date = r.return_date; ```
